data.description: Learn when and how to use personal protective equipment before entering a work area.

attributes.name: richText
attributes.text:
Always wear required PPE before entering the work area. Check gloves, helmet, and safety glasses.

Report damaged equipment to your supervisor immediately.

attributes.name: flipCard
attributes.text: [{"front":{"title":"Question","description":"When must PPE be worn?"},"back":{"title":"Answer","description":"Before entering the work area."}}]

attributes.name: richText
attributes.text: Key takeaway: PPE is mandatory, not optional. A 30-second check can prevent serious injury.
